name: Cosmic Shift stealths an ally and does not break on damage taken (#797)
contract: Cosmic Shift 801134 (SpellFamilyName 32) reads "Shift the target ally out of the physical plane, granting improved stealth for $d. Does not break on damage taken." Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_STEALTH (16) with EffectBasePoints 999 (stealth level 1000) on implicit target 21 (TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY), DurationIndex 1 = 10 s. AuraInterruptFlags is 0x0c020004: it carries neither AURA_INTERRUPT_FLAG_TAKE_DAMAGE (0x2) nor DIRECT_DAMAGE (0x01000000), and Unit::DealDamage only strips auras through RemoveAurasWithInterruptFlags(AURA_INTERRUPT_FLAG_TAKE_DAMAGE) (Unit.cpp, the damagetype != NODAMAGE branch), so damage leaves it up: that is the tooltip's last sentence, and it needs no module code (no module reference to 801134). AuraEffect::HandleModStealth adds the value to m_stealth on any target, ally included. The fixture applies the damage the way chronomancer-borrowed-time-heal does: Gnomish Death Ray 13493 (SchoolMask 1, SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_DAMAGE, amplitude 1000, EffectBasePoints 149) via set_aura on the ally, which is a real DealDamage on a player. The scenario asserts the ally lost health (so damage really went through DealDamage) and that Cosmic Shift is still applied afterwards, well inside its 10 s duration (about 4 s elapse). Stock rules that do remove it, and are not tested: casting a spell (interrupt flag 0x4) and being hit by a hostile non-triggered spell. Both fixtures are class 26, race 1, so they are friendly and the ally cast is valid at the harness's default spawn spacing.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Cast Cosmic Shift on the ally
The ally is stealthed by Cosmic Shift
Damage the ally with Gnomish Death Ray
Let at least two Death Ray ticks land
